Welcome to the SM NeverUsed Cup, part of this year’s NU Classic Cups!

The NU Classic this year consists of Eight cups featuring generations ranging from RBY to SS. Players can earn points from their placements in each cup as well as our 2 Later OG tours to compete in a top 16 OG circuit playoffs. More information on the new format can be found here.

Tournament Rules:​
  • This is a standard SM NU tournament.​
  • Best of three, single elimination.​
  • Matches are to be played on Pokemon Showdown!​
  • Saving replays is mandatory for this tournament. In the event of a dispute you must be able to prove that you won your game. I would strongly encourage you to play your games on the Smogon Tournaments PS! Server since it automatically saves replays.​
  • Do not make baseless activity posts, get in contact with your opponent and report missed times / scheduling issues only.​
  • Standard clauses apply. All the usual Smogon rules regarding activity, timer, disconnection, and ghosting rules apply. General tournament rules and regulations can be found here.​
